title_en: Prosecutors order the detention of Francisco Peña, the former President's brother, in the Pear S.R.L. line of case 92/2026
title_es: La Fiscalía ordena la detención de Francisco Peña, hermano del expresidente, en la línea Pear S.R.L. de la causa 92/2026
detail_en: Ministerio Público release: by Resolución Fiscal 12 of 23 Nov 2026 (art. 240 CPP, detention to secure a statement) prosecutors ordered the detention of Francisco Peña Palacios and his wife, both linked to Pear S.R.L. The hypothesis: Pear was the vehicle to buy a 1,184 ha rural property for about USD 3 million through an operation linked to the then Financiera Ueno, and the loan instalments were met by Grupo Vázquez companies; invoices of June and August 2026 for USD 739,000 and G. 295.65 million for forage are under analysis. Suspected offences: money laundering and administration for own benefit. No charge yet; presumed innocent.
detail_es: La Fiscalía ordena la detención de Francisco Peña, hermano del expresidente, en la línea Pear S.R.L. de la causa 92/2026. (Detalle completo solo en inglés.)

title_en: ABC, from the prosecutors' file: how dormant Pear S.R.L. came to hold the Paraguarí property
title_es: ABC, según la carpeta fiscal: cómo la inactiva Pear S.R.L. pasó a tener el inmueble de Paraguarí
detail_en: ABC, citing the prosecutors' file: Pear S.R.L. was formed in November 2020 and had no activity; in August 2023 Francisco Peña asked an acquaintance for a company to buy a rural property and was offered Pear; on 7 Sep 2023 Financiera Ueno, represented by Julio Rey and Juan Manuel Gustale, transferred the 1,184 ha property with a mortgage loan; he received a general power of attorney in November 2023 and the quotas in February 2024. The earlier partners and the notary are private persons and are not named here.
detail_es: ABC, según la carpeta fiscal: cómo la inactiva Pear S.R.L. pasó a tener el inmueble de Paraguarí. (Detalle completo solo en inglés.)

title_en: Peña asks the Supreme Court to annul his removal by the Senate
title_es: Peña pide a la Corte Suprema anular su destitución por el Senado
detail_en: Peña files unconstitutionality action against his removal: at 08:20 on 23 Nov his lawyer Ricardo Preda filed an acción de inconstitucionalidad before the Sala Constitucional of the Supreme Court (ministers Gustavo Santander, Víctor Ríos Ojeda, César Diesel) seeking nullity of Senate Resolución N.º 3 of 6 Nov 2026 (impeachment for mal desempeño). He alleges violation of arts. 16 (defence), 17 (due process, incs. 7–9) and 256 of the Constitution: the accusation and a >300-page file were delivered at 22:15 with the hearing at 10:00 the next morning (~12 night hours), a 72-hour extension was refused, and 'illicit' evidence (untraceable recordings, press items, third-party invoices) was used;
detail_es: Peña pide a la Corte Suprema anular su destitución por el Senado. (Detalle completo solo en inglés.)

title_en: Charging document 11: Santiago Peña also charged with money laundering and aggravated passive bribery; his brother and sister-in-law charged
title_es: Acta de Imputación 11: Santiago Peña también imputado por lavado de activos y cohecho pasivo agravado; imputan a su hermano y a su cuñada
detail_en: Ministerio Público, Acta de Imputación 11 in case 92/2026, filed 24 Nov: former President Santiago Peña is additionally charged with money laundering (co-perpetrator) and aggravated passive bribery, on top of breach of trust, administration for own benefit and criminal association. Francisco Peña is charged with money laundering, complicity in aggravated passive bribery, criminal association and complicity in administration for own benefit; his wife with money laundering. Requested: pre-trial detention for him, house arrest with ankle monitor for her, asset measures on both and on Pear S.R.L., six months to conclude. Hypothesis: Pear bought the 1,184 ha property for USD 3 million from the then Financiera Ueno with the lender's own financing, and instalments were paid with transfers from Grupo Vázquez and ITTI accounts backed by Pear invoices. Charges are allegations; all presumed innocent.

title_en: Securities regulator orders brokerage accounts transferred on request; Ueno AFPISA starts asking unitholders whether they want to redeem; loan penalties waived to 30 Nov
title_es: El regulador de valores ordena traspasar cuentas bursátiles a pedido; Ueno AFPISA empieza a consultar a los cuotapartistas si quieren rescatar; multas de préstamos suspendidas hasta el 30 de noviembre
detail_en: ABC and others, 24 Nov: (a) by Resolution SV.SG. 0018/2026 the securities superintendency instructed the depository to transfer each Ueno Casa de Bolsa client's account to another depositary at the client's request, without the suspended broker; (b) Ueno AFPISA began e-mailing unitholders their units at the 6 Nov cut-off and asking whether they want to redeem once a procedure exists, with no dates or cash values; about 30,000 investors remain outside the deposit guarantee; (c) the interveners remind Ueno borrowers that no payment channel exists yet and that default and penalty interest is waived until 30 Nov 2026.
detail_es: El regulador de valores ordena traspasar cuentas bursátiles a pedido; Ueno AFPISA empieza a consultar a los cuotapartistas si quieren rescatar; multas de préstamos suspendidas hasta el 30 de noviembre. (Detalle completo solo en inglés.)

title_en: A bondholders' group counts about USD 365 million of bonds outstanding, some 70% issued by group companies and not the bank
title_es: Un grupo de bonistas calcula unos USD 365 millones en bonos en circulación, cerca del 70% emitidos por empresas del grupo y no por el banco
detail_en: Bondholders: a group of >300 holders (spokesperson Karina Ferrari, ÚH) says ueno and linked firms have ~US$365M of bonds outstanding, only ~30% issued by the bank and ~70% by Grupo Vázquez, itti, U Holding, Terravaz (which absorbed Radici six months ago) and smaller firms such as La Tropa, and asks that those firms' assets not be used to plug the bank's hole; ITTI S.A.E. bondholders meet on 10 Dec to weigh restructuring or acceleration of 21 series after missed coupons — ITTI bonds ~US$40M, total financial debt US$66M at June 2026 per FIX SCR (5Días). Figures are claimants'/press estimates.
detail_es: Un grupo de bonistas calcula unos USD 365 millones en bonos en circulación, cerca del 70% emitidos por empresas del grupo y no por el banco. (Detalle completo solo en inglés.)

title_en: Bankers say the association warned Peña about Ueno; economists call the 2024 merger plan cosmetic
title_es: Banqueros dicen que el gremio advirtió a Peña sobre Ueno; economistas califican de 'maquillado' el plan de fusión de 2024
detail_en: Industry/analyst view of the ueno–Visión merger: Asoban representatives Conor McEnroy (Sudameris) and Osvaldo Serafini (GNB), on Sen. Gustavo Leite's podcast, said the banks' association warned President Peña that ueno would bring down his government (no date/circumstances given); Serafini cites the 'pecado original' (merger approved on those terms — 'la aritmética luego ya no cerró') and the 'pecado capital' (the emptying of the bank) (ABC). Economists Víctor Raúl Benítez and Jorge Garicoche (ÚH, on BCP file EXP-2024-004110) call the plan 'maquillado': 20-year deferral of a G. 2.68 tn (~US$420M) impaired Visión portfolio, 0% risk weight for deferred assets, deferrals + trust G.
detail_es: Banqueros dicen que el gremio advirtió a Peña sobre Ueno; economistas califican de 'maquillado' el plan de fusión de 2024. (Detalle completo solo en inglés.)

title_en: ABC publishes details of the 'Delirio colectivo' file: a 14-month cash projection negative in every month
title_es: ABC publica detalles del informe 'Delirio colectivo': una proyección de caja a 14 meses negativa todos los meses
detail_en: ABC, from a 20-page document it says staff gave it and prosecutors hold: dated September 2025 (e-mailed 13 Oct 2025), it said liquid securities were fully pledged daily, institutional-deposit concentration rose from 16% to 31%, several liquidity ratios were breached, disbursements were frozen and suppliers paid late; a cash projection for Aug 2025 to Sep 2026 was negative every month. An internal document as reported by one outlet; not a finding.
detail_es: ABC publica detalles del informe 'Delirio colectivo': una proyección de caja a 14 meses negativa todos los meses. (Detalle completo solo en inglés.)

title_en: Última Hora, from the BCP file: supervisors judged the Ueno-Visión merger plan viable in May 2024 and the board approved the absorption on 21 Jun 2024
title_es: Última Hora, según el expediente del BCP: los supervisores consideraron viable el plan de fusión Ueno-Visión en mayo de 2024 y el directorio aprobó la absorción el 21 de junio de 2024
detail_en: Última Hora and RDN (24 Nov), from the central bank's file: a joint report of the banking superintendency dated 16 May 2024 found the feasibility plan economically viable, recommended proceeding and judged the 20-year horizon reasonable, with twelve officials signing, most within one hour; the legal unit found no breach; the board authorised continuing on 27 May and approved the absorption on 21 Jun 2024. The file shows no valuation supporting the share-swap ratio, per the outlets.
detail_es: Última Hora, según el expediente del BCP: los supervisores consideraron viable el plan de fusión Ueno-Visión en mayo de 2024 y el directorio aprobó la absorción el 21 de junio de 2024. (Detalle completo solo en inglés.)
